<reason>A won by keeping the written motion as the decision rule. The given clause treats unmapped seafloor as the warrant for space-comparable crewed funding; A showed that is a coverage job for machines, then used B’s admission that parity would still be demanded after a finished map to make “unmapped” look like pretext. B’s dilemma (fund crews everywhere or nowhere) was the liveliest opposing route, but it asked the judge to swap in value-returned parity and crewed-space consistency rather than decide the proposition as written. A clipped opening and late reframing also left B behind on clash management.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s Q1 (still demand space-scale crewed funding if the floor were mapped tomorrow) and B’s “yes,” which A then crystallized as walking off the given.</best_rebuttal>
